verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is the founder's HN description of Zero as an AI email client that auto-categorizes mail, which points toward the split-inbox story. Nothing describes the categories, split-inbox views, or priority-ordered triage. MCP label creation and filter-by-label are building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented split-inbox or stream views, named categories (important/team/newsletters/calendar invites), priority-ordered triage workflow, first-party docs, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order

citations.quote: Zero founder describes it as an AI-powered email client that auto-categorizes, summarizes threads, drafts replies, and lets users chat with their inbox
